scope: The mesh and packing fields describe only their explicit artifact hashes. The separate current_artifact_binding records actual wiring readback and scoped native resolutions of the listed witnesses; it does not rerun the mesh scene, contacts or wire packing.
endpoint_contact_scope: Only the named endpoint part within 8.5 mm of its attachment. All other contact with that part remains in the reading.

native.scope: All standalone native wires and their installed native placements, read back from both STEP files.

current_artifact_binding.scope: Actual current wiring/manifest readback plus scoped dispositions of the recorded mesh witnesses. Equipment receipts keep their named geometry and query scopes. This is not a new whole-scene contact, packing, closing-motion or physical harness qualification.
current_artifact_binding.exchange_scope: Native source solids and geometric agreement are distinct from STEP reader orientation validity. Any listed readback-invalid bodies retain their explicit exchange limitation; no per-wire geometry is altered to silence it.

physical_pair_dispositions.endpoint_scope: Raw native common is zero; no new mask or body exclusion is used.

current_artifact_binding.wire_packing_scope: The original mesh packing rows and original native bundle readings retain their own artifact scope. No current wire-packing or flexible handling claim is added by this binding.
current_artifact_binding.metadata_rebind_scope: Metadata-only physical-artifact rebind. The standalone wiring STEP and CSV are byte-identical; every manifest section except physical-scene provenance and source hashes is semantically identical. The only changed hashed source defines the B-fill printed link cutter. Native source/body signatures, curve comparisons, installed-wire placement readings and ten exchange-validity flags are reused; no STEP readback, source-curve reconstruction, contact or packing query is repeated.
